statement: In the standard real/tangential GT framing, the unique maximal closed algebraically ample subgroup containing c=(-1,1) is the standard arithmetic image. An outer family on all full profinite mapping-class groups is induced by a unique element of G_Q if and only if it admits the specified coherent labelled/coloured cover-and-filling autoequivalence and one such extension has complete genus-zero system equal to the standard GT action of an element of the selected subgroup.
where_proved: sections/E_arithmetic_selection_extension.tex, claim E.14 and its complete proof
manuscript_passages: 142; manuscript p.8, scan17, and pp.8v–10, scans18–21
notes: The full AA hypotheses COF, RGC, ArBC and all clauses of Definition5.12 are retained. AA means algebraically ample. Framing changes transport the involution and selected subgroup together. No GT=G_Q, all-types lifting of an arbitrary GT conjugator, classification of all autoequivalences, or algorithmic decidability is asserted. Uniqueness for an unlabelled family uses the n=5 pure subgroup before deletion to n=4. Supersedes the earlier E.U2 obligation; two independent reviews and a root review are retained.
